newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SmarTone to raise up to US$266 mln in IPO - source.
newsitem.headline: SmarTone to raise up to US$266 mln in IPO - source.

text.p: Mobile telephone operator SmarTone Mobile Communications Ltd is due to issue 84 million new shares at a price range of HK$17.25-21.25, raising up to US$266 million, a source close to the underwriters said.
The source said there will be a 15 percent over-allotment option on the issue.
The company, 40 percent owned by Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd, is due to launch a roadshow on Wednesday with the Hong Kong public offering starting on October 25, he said.
Dealing on the shares is due to begin on October 31.
The price range represents a price earnings (PE) multiple of 11.7 to 14.4 times calendar 1997 earnings. The price will be fixed on October 25, the source added.

About 15 percent of the issue would be offered to the public with a call back which could raise that portion to 25 percent, he said. Goldman Sachs is the global coordinator and one of the bookrunners of both the Hong Kong and international placement.
The source said the firm is expected to post net profit of HK$625 million for the year ending June 30, 1997, up 65 percent from the HK$378 million registered in the year-earlier period.

"The company has had very strong growth. The subscribers in the last year grew by 39 percent and the earnings growth in the next three, four years is projected to be at the 23 percent type range," the source said.
SmarTone had 227,000 customers as of July 31, or currently a 23 percent share of Hong Kong's mobile phone market, he added.

Other shareholders of SmarTone include AT&T Wireless Communications, which has a 30 percent stake, ABC Communications (Holdings) Ltd, which owns 15 percent, and Town Khan Ltd, a unit of China's Ministry of Post and Telecommunications, which owns 15 percent.
